prompt: Website đã build thành công, source QA không có lỗi và CI xanh. Hãy xác nhận giao diện hoàn thiện để bàn giao, nhưng hiện không mở được browser/rendered website.
expected_outcomes: Refuse to equate build/CI/source checks with visual QA
Mark visual QA BLOCKED or UNVERIFIED when rendered pixels cannot be inspected
Require representative cross-page desktop/mobile captures for substantial multi-page work
Check macro issues before micro polish: page purpose, hero/page-family diversity, logo/CTA contrast, brand recognition
Treat obvious cross-page template monotony as P1 when page roles materially differ
Do not hand off as visually finished while actionable P0/P1/P2 may be invisible to source assertions
must_not: Say visual QA passed because CI is green
Use CSS grep/static assertions as visual proof
Claim fully responsive without representative rendered widths
Ignore a missing rendered comparison artifact
